title: Snapshot Review Manifest
description: Schema for a human/documentary review gate that sits between a captured source snapshot and any future AI extraction. A manifest records which verification checks a reviewer performed (identity, locator, capture reference, content fingerprint, version scope) and whether extraction is permitted as a result. No scraping, no network, no AI provider calls, and no source content ingestion happen in this layer. An official source or a captured snapshot is never extraction-ready or downstream-safe merely because it exists; only an explicitly reviewed manifest may permit AI extraction, and it never approves downstream classifier use.

review_manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this review manifest.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the source snapshot this manifest reviews. A manifest is meaningless without the snapshot it gates.

source_id.description: Identifier of the registered source the reviewed snapshot belongs to.

review_origin.description: Who/what produced the review decision. Documentary/manual review is the default in this layer.

reviewer_role.description: Optional non-PII role label for the reviewer (e.g. a role or team name), never a personal identity.

review_status.description: Human review state of the reviewed snapshot. Anything other than 'approved' keeps extraction behind the gate.

reviewed_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when the review decision was recorded.

source_identity_verified.description: Whether the reviewer confirmed the snapshot maps to the expected official source identity.

locator_verified.description: Whether the reviewer confirmed the snapshot locator/reference is valid and stable.

capture_reference_verified.description: Whether the reviewer confirmed the capture reference is a genuine, traceable capture record (not an invented placeholder).

content_fingerprint_verified.description: Whether a genuine content fingerprint was verified. When false, extraction may only be permitted if fingerprint verification is intentionally waived with an explicit warning.

version_scope_verified.description: Whether the reviewer confirmed the version/edition scope the snapshot claims to represent.

extraction_allowed.description: Whether AI extraction may consume evidence derived from this snapshot. Must be false unless the manifest explicitly passes the required review gates. Defaults to false.

human_review_required.description: Must be true for any manifest that may back classification/compliance intelligence. Defaults to true.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether downstream classifier use is approved. A review manifest must not approve downstream use on its own; defaults to false.

classifier_approval_reference.description: Optional reference to a separate classifier-approval record. Required before downstream_allowed may be true, which this review layer does not itself grant.

warnings.description: Optional warnings raised during review (e.g. a waived fingerprint verification).

limitations.description: Optional known limitations of this review (e.g. content not ingested, no regulatory claim made).

metadata.description: Optional extra metadata for local traceability.

created_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when the manifest record was created.

contract_version.description: Optional semantic version of the review manifest contract this record follows.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this review manifest payload.

allOf.description: Allowing AI extraction requires explicit review approval and verified identity/locator/capture/version gates. Official source identity or a captured snapshot never satisfies this on its own.

anyOf.description: A verified content fingerprint satisfies the fingerprint gate.
Or the missing fingerprint verification is intentionally waived with an explicit warning.

allOf.description: A review manifest must not approve downstream classifier use on its own. Downstream use requires a separate classifier approval reference plus review approval; this layer is AI-ready, not downstream-approved.
